CA.rationale: A processing-kind (command_estimate) is attached to the same candidate content entry that names a color.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an explicit origin/status, and an access/presentation tag are all present and bound to p1/current/n1.

A.rationale: A processing/command-estimate kind is explicitly attached to the named candidate content entry, linking processing condition to that content's representation.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content (color) and spatial attribute tuples.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status field is given separate from the content coordinates, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Entries label items as current/candidate and include origin/represented_time tags indicating presentation/access organization.
